contentText:
Leaked images of Google’s upcoming Fitbit Edge shared by Android Headlines. | Image: Android Headlines

Following more images of the previously leaked Google Fitbit Edge surfacing a few days ago , new details about the upcoming fitness tracker have been revealed, including potential features and pricing. The Fitbit Edge will reportedly sell for €179 in Europe, and £159 in the UK, according to leaked details shared by Dealabs . Given the €99/£85 pricing of the $99 screen-free Fitbit Air in those regions, 9to5Google estimates the new Fitbit Edge will cost around $180 in the US.
